difficulty_reason: The independent lower-bound reduction combines a bounded-occurrence SAT geometric embedding with midpoint clustering clients and a global accounting of deficient, surplus and invalid local covers. It proves that small clustering excess cost allows decoding an assignment with few bad clauses, then calibrates epsilon as n^(-1/(d-1)) to contradict Gap-ETH. These source-specific gap-preservation steps are separate from the portal approximation construction and remain fully in the task.
